title: Yesterday’s situation is different today
literal_meaning: Yesterday’s state of affairs is different by today.
meaning_odia: ଗତକାଲି ଯେପରି ଅବସ୍ଥା ଥିଲା, ଆଜି ସେପରି ରହିନାହିଁ। ସଂସାର ଓ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ବଦଳୁଥାଏ—କାଲି ଓ ଆଜିର ଛୋଟ ବ୍ୟବଧାନରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଫରକ ଆସିପାରେ।
explanation: The saying observes that circumstances change, even across the short distance between yesterday and today. The inspected source gloss gives this general sense of a changing world. It invites a fresh look at the present situation.
usage_example: A plan made yesterday needs revising after the available arrangements change overnight. Someone recalls the saying while checking what is possible now. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: There is no elaborate story: yesterday and today stand side by side. Their closeness makes the change feel immediate, while ଅନ୍ତର supplies the contrast.

witnesses.locator: Page10, single line beginning କାଲିକା କଥା.

witnesses.note: Variant କାଲିର instead of କାଲିକା; explicit gloss describes a changing world.

origin_note: Upload attests କାଲିକା; OdiaVasa gives କାଲିର and a general changeability gloss. Earliest circulation and lineage unknown.
